chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 493: Han Li Snatches a Shape-Shifting Treasure While Nascent Soul Monsters Fight
chapter_meta_description: While Extreme Yin and Wan Tianming battle for the Void Heaven Cauldron, Han Li casually snatches a shape-shifting silver wolf treasure. But a deadly blue frost is about to change everything.
og_title: The Weakest Man Just Won the Prize
og_description: Han Li’s best trick yet: let the Nascent Soul monsters fight, and grab their treasure while they’re not looking.
twitter_title: Han Li just stole a legendary treasure
twitter_description: While Extreme Yin and Wan Tianming duel for the Void Heaven Cauldron, Han Li casually bags a shape-shifting ancient treasure. Classic Mortal Stream.

lore_anchors.definition: The Patriarch of Extreme Yin Island, a leading Nascent Soul cultivator of the demonic path in the Chaotic Star Sea.
The Sect Leader of the Ten Thousand Laws Sect, a leading Nascent Soul cultivator of the righteous path in the Chaotic Star Sea.
A thousand-year-old undead cultivator who sacrificed his physical form for vengeance; exists as a Profound Soul Body.
The legendary supreme treasure sealed in the innermost chamber of the Void Heaven Palace; the primary objective of the expedition.
A signature demonic-flame technique of Extreme Yin Island, capable of countering even mysterious blue frost.
A magic weapon from an ancient era, often more powerful than modern equivalents and sometimes capable of shape-shifting into living beasts.
The crystallized spiritual essence of a high-level cultivator at the third major realm; capable of independent survival and escape.
The characteristic energy of the Profound Yin Grand Technique, a core demonic art of Extreme Yin Island.
